summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new access control features: Admin Pusat can disable bonus types and block pages for members (both individual and bulk), with global settings support. All backend tests passed (37/37), frontend UI elements verified, and secrecy requirements confirmed.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/members/bulk/access - individual member bonus/page restrictions
Backend: POST /api/members/bulk/access - bulk member restrictions (multiple members at once)
Backend: PUT /api/settings - global bonus_disabled_global and pages_blocked_global
Backend: GET /api/access/options - returns 7 bonus types, pages list, and roles (admin_pusat only, 403 for others)
Backend: GET /api/access/member/{id} - shows current restrictions for a member (admin_pusat only)
Backend: Bonus calculation - disabled bonuses = 0 BV with no detail lines
Backend: Page blocking - blocked pages return 403, Dashboard always returns 200
Backend: Secrecy - members don't see bonus_disabled, access_set_by, access_set_at fields
Backend: Secrecy - members don't see bonus_disabled_global, pages_blocked_global in /settings
Backend: Secrecy - /bonus/statement doesn't mention 'disabled' or 'nonaktif'
Backend: Login response includes blocked_pages array (OK for member to see)
Backend: GET /auth/me includes blocked_pages but not secret fields
Backend: Validation - unknown bonus types rejected (400)
Backend: Validation - unknown pages rejected (400)
Backend: Validation - empty member_ids rejected (400)
Backend: Validation - Admin Pusat cannot be restricted (failed array with reason)
Backend: Validation - pages not applicable to role rejected (failed array)
Backend: Reset - clear_bonus:true and clear_pages:true restore original state
Backend: Global restrictions - bonus_disabled_global affects all members
Backend: Global restrictions - pages_blocked_global affects all members of specified role
Backend: Effective restrictions - combination of global + per-member restrictions
Backend: Dashboard - returns 200 even when statement page blocked (history emptied)
Frontend: Login successful as Admin Pusat (ADMIN / admin123)

Frontend: Settings page - Pages-off card visible with role-based page checkboxes
Frontend: Settings page - Global settings persist after save and reload

Frontend: Members page - Badges visible showing restrictions (1 bonus off, 2 halaman)
Frontend: Members page - Bulk selection checkboxes present
Frontend: AccessDialog component - Opens for individual member
Frontend: AccessDialog component - Shows bonus and page checkboxes
Frontend: AccessDialog component - Displays warning about secrecy
